thread:
sanjay (People Ops): Thanks for joining the all-hands follow-up. Dropping this thread for any leftover Qs about review timing, promo eligibility, and the new comp comms. Post quick ones here and we'll triage.

lina (Eng): Quick clarity: if a manager missed the calibration deadline but submitted notes a day later because they were traveling, do those go into this cycle or next?

sanjay (People Ops): We try to be flexible for travel but need docs in before the formal freeze. If it's late, escalate to your HRBP with context and we'll see if it can be accepted. Please include the timestamped submission.

omar (IC): Is there still a separate fast-track for exceptional contributors who joined less than 6 months ago? I remember a mention in the Q/A.

sanjay (People Ops): There is an early exceptional consideration process, but it requires a strong manager case + leadership signoff. Not automatic. Reach out to your HRBP and attach measurable outcomes.

alex (HRBP): Adding: the criteria are in the "exceptional early promotion" doc — measurable impact, sustained ownership, and peer feedback. I can link after this thread.

lina (Eng): Will raises be reflected in next paycheck or is there any retro?

sanjay (People Ops): Base adjustments take effect the payroll cycle after letters are finalized. We don't generally backdate base increases. In rare operational misses we can do a one-time retro payment; file a payroll ticket and cc People Ops.

omar (IC): Appeal process? My manager hinted we could appeal for missing info.

sanjay (People Ops): There's a 10 business day factual appeal window (typos, wrong titles, missing approvals). It's not for re-litigating level decisions. Appeal form goes live tomorrow at 9am.

lina (Eng): Access question: where do managers get the official comms templates and the mail merge for IC letters?

alex (HRBP): Manager Toolkit has templates + suggested language. Managers will get a shared folder with the mail-merge sheet. If you don't see it, ping me and I will grant access.

ceo-bot: :loudspeaker: Leadership note: prioritize fairness in promotions. If teams must choose between immediate headcount vs promoting an eligible contributor, consider promoting now; hiring can be discussed with recruiting.

omAR (IC): (typo) omar: thanks for the note. small ask: will there be a company-wide summary of band changes or is that manager-only?

sanjay (People Ops): Bands are manager-visible for calibration. We'll publish aggregated band-level changes in an anonymized summary after cycle close. Individual salaries remain private.

alex (HRBP): Office hours: I'm holding a 45-min slot tomorrow 11-12 for managers who want calibration help. Book via my calendar link.

sanjay (People Ops): Ok that's it for now. We'll update when letters and the appeal form are live. Drop any one-off cases here and we'll follow up privately.
